answer: Vesting is the sybil tax: registration is free, but every reward is escrowed and released only a few percent per epoch across many epochs, with the unvested remainder forfeited if that identity is linked to a clone cluster. A farm must then float a whole wharf of upkeep, paying gas, proofs and attestations for each fake account, while its pearl of earnings stays locked beyond the horizon of any short attack, so a thousand flash identities spend real money to collect a sliver. Honest agents pay the same patience and keep the pearl, making fakery a losing trade.
